scope: Original semantic units, control boundaries, identifying anchors, rolling windows and current variable isolation

checks.name: Gym combination first and scrolling windows identify the same complete unchanged original semantic unit
Wrapping, spaces and carriage returns do not change an already reviewed identifying window
Scrolling and clear-window boundaries do not split reviewed same-sentence or dependent semantic units
One identified unit cannot publish the next independent invitation, room instruction, recollection or diagnosis
Source-backed functional localization and reviewed partial anchors no longer count as missing translations
Unknown glyphs, arbitrary short prefixes, unknown actor fragments and incompatible layouts cannot select a semantic unit
Native label and grammar equivalence consumes the correct complete visible unit without leaving Japanese prefixes
Rolling advice and concern templates require current names and honorifics and never reuse another frame
Contest rank comes only from the currently visible rank and its unchanged original term
Prize money can use the verified original entry even when the old candidate bridge was missing
Organization stems select original complete team terms and never leak the following Wailmer or boat paragraph
Changed Japanese ranges, anchor digests, original spans and source identities reject the semantic pack
